gate_iv_invariance_measurement.why: #591 has asked the director to re-derive the changeover constant for four rounds. This round measured, rather than argued, what re-deriving it could buy.
gate_iv_invariance_measurement.finding_1_UNSATISFIABLE: The real, unmutated tool refuses for EVERY constant swept from 10 to 120 minutes (17 values). The bracket is not 'wrong at 40.0', it is UNSATISFIABLE on this input: clause (a) needs c <= 39.6 (seed 7156 is paired at 39.6 min) while clause (b) needs c >= 48.5 (seed 7162 was reclaimed at 48.5 min and counted unpaired). 48.5 > 39.6 => empty feasible set. Both edges quoted verbatim from the tool at c=39.6 and c=48.5. CONSEQUENCE: re-deriving the constant -- exactly what #591 asks for -- CANNOT clear this gate on W53, at any value.
gate_iv_invariance_measurement.finding_2_VERDICT_INVARIANT: On a mutation stand (a file COPY with only the bracket short-circuit removed; the shipped tool was not touched) the verdict is 'not blinded -- the wave delivered 2 paired seed(s)' for every constant from 10 to 120 min. Mechanism, read off the source, not inferred: BLINDED requires BOTH (1) paired_n <= 1 AND (2) an early capacity reclaim; classify_machine() takes changeover_min as a parameter but never reads it, so paired_n is constant-independent, and at paired_n=2 the attribution clause (the only consumer of the constant) is unreachable. The attribution count does move across the sweep (0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3) and never reaches the branch.
gate_iv_invariance_measurement.finding_3_THE_FIX_IS_THE_LABEL: Running the REAL tool with --min-arm-depth 5.0 (which lets seed 7162's ba leg of depth 5.60 count as a pairing, i.e. probes what the desk's own 15:14Z proposal -- split PAIRED into NO-PAIR/THIN-ARM/PAIRED -- would do to clause (b)) makes the bracket SATISFIABLE on the interval [31.3, 39.6], and inside it the unmutated tool returns exit 0 / not blinded. The 15:14Z measured constant 39.6 +/- 0.4 lands on that interval's upper edge; the hard-coded 40.0 sits just OUTSIDE it. HONESTY BOUNDARY: --min-arm-depth 5.0 is a PROBE of the bracket's feasibility, NOT a proposal to lower the depth bar -- the depth bar is GH #269's promote-side门 and this desk is not touching it.
gate_iv_invariance_measurement.what_is_NOT_claimed: Not claimed: that gate (iv) passed, that exit 2 may be read as a pass, or that this reasoning generalises to a future wave. It is input-specific: on the NEXT harvested wave the desk re-runs the gate and re-measures, and if paired_n <= 1 there the constant becomes load-bearing again and the market goes back to depending on #591.

rerun.status_code_deadline_postmortem: The launch round predicted the code would stay readable until ~00:35Z by anchoring on the 2h WATCHDOG CEILING (23:35Z + ~1h). The machine did not run to the watchdog: its last S3 upload is 22:18:31Z, and by the spot machines' own upload->terminate gap (2m32s / 4m22s) it self-terminated ~22:21-22:23Z, which closed the ~1h window near 23:25Z -- about 70 minutes EARLIER than the predicted deadline. The estimate failed toward the DANGEROUS side (it said there was time when there was not), because the deadline is anchored to ACTUAL termination and a self-terminating machine beats its own watchdog by design. Any future deadline of this kind must be anchored on expected COMPLETION, not on the watchdog ceiling.
